alerts.title: Authentication Method Downgrade
alerts.description: User "synthetic-release-bot" authentication downgraded from passkey to password (reason: offline export compatibility test) from IP 192.0.2.44. Forced downgrades are a common AitM proxy technique.
mitigations: Block authentication downgrades for accounts with passkeys enrolled
If downgrade is necessary, require additional verification step
Monitor for user-agent spoofing that triggers downgrade paths
